description: This file is a PHP source code for the Cart controller in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles checkout cart functionalities such as displaying the cart, adding, editing, removing products, and generating JSON responses for AJAX interactions.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class for managing shopping cart operations in the checkout process within OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main cart page with various components like header, footer, and cart content.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the cart list directly via response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML or data for the cart contents, including products and totals.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Provides a JSON representation of the cart data for AJAX calls, including products, totals, and URLs.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart with options, subscription plan, and handles validation.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a cart item identified by a key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart based on the item key.
